title: Sliver opacity starts one frame late
evidence: Frame 0 geometry and opacity match. At frame 4 (64 ms) Flutter is 0.99632 and Incular is 1.0. Incular frame 5 equals Flutter frame 4. Both reach 0.25 at frame 26.
impact: The visible fade trajectory lags Flutter by one 16 ms frame, then converges to the same target.
cause: Adopted retained sliver state schedules forward_on_next_tick after the current frame's tick; Flutter starts the controller during didUpdateWidget.
fix_direction: Establish the adopted animation before the first post-update tick so its elapsed timeline matches Flutter.
limitations: One scenario with one target change.

title: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle has intermittent one-pixel line-box drift
evidence: Frame 0 matches. Widths differ by less than 0.00002 px; top and bottom differ by 0.5 px on five intermediate frames (also in transitions__text__default_style).
impact: A text widget's bounds can shift by one logical pixel during a font-size animation, moving nearby content.
cause: Tween progress and width agree; the difference is in line-box metrics at fractional Inter font sizes, probably text-engine metric rounding.
fix_direction: Compare Flutter and Incular line metrics for the same Inter font sizes and align fractional-size line-box rounding.
limitations: Only Inter at the sampled sizes was measured.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: Implicit layout widgets cannot animate directional geometry
evidence: Setters accept only Alignment and physical EdgeInsets (rg for AlignmentGeometry/EdgeInsetsGeometry/Directional in implicit_animations.rs finds only AnimatedPositionedDirectional). Incular's directional types are not accepted by these widgets.
impact: RTL callers cannot preserve start/end alignment or insets through AnimatedContainer, AnimatedPadding, AnimatedAlign or AnimatedFractionallySizedBox, and cannot interpolate mixed geometry.
cause: Setter and tween storage are specialized to physical Alignment and EdgeInsets.
fix_direction: Accept Flutter-equivalent geometry values and interpolate them with direction-aware lerps.
limitations: Source review only; no frame twin can express the input.

title: Opacity widgets cannot match Flutter's semantic visibility option
evidence: descriptors.rs:1279-1295 states opacity never affects semantic exposure; no always-include flag exists on the opacity widgets.
impact: At zero opacity, assistive technology may announce or navigate content that Flutter hides by default; callers cannot opt into Flutter's alwaysIncludeSemantics.
cause: Incular opacity is paint-only for semantic exposure and has no policy field.
fix_direction: Add the flag to box and sliver opacity widgets and apply it when projecting semantics, defaulting to false.
limitations: The frame recorder has no semantics view; source only.

title: AnimatedPhysicalModel has no circular shape option
evidence: implicit_animations.rs:1170 documents the widget as a rounded rectangle with no shape counterpart to Flutter's BoxShape.
impact: Callers cannot create a circular physical model or match its clip and shadow silhouette.
cause: The physical-model descriptor stores corner radii only.
fix_direction: Add a shape field to the widget and renderer-neutral descriptor, with matching paint and clip.
limitations: Source review only; the frame recorder cannot observe shadow or clip.

title: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle omits Flutter paragraph options
evidence: implicit_animations.rs:1125 notes that textAlign, softWrap, overflow and maxLines have no counterpart; the constructor takes only style, duration and child.
impact: Callers cannot configure inherited paragraph wrapping, truncation, alignment or line height through the animated style widget.
cause: The default-text-style descriptor carries only TextStyle.
fix_direction: Add the paragraph options and pass them through to the default-style scope.

title: Curve-only update mid-flight is ignored until the next target change
evidence: A curve change from easeInOut to linear at frame 10 with an unchanged target. Flutter's values after frame 10 keep the easeInOut shape (step sizes rise then fall); Incular switches to linear steps of about 0.0375 per frame at once. Source: didUpdateWidget recreates _animation on a curve change (389-391), but AnimatedOpacity rebinds _opacityAnimation = animation.drive(...) only in didUpdateTweens (1897-1900), which runs only when a target changes, so the FadeTransition keeps the disposed previous CurvedAnimation.
impact: A mid-flight curve change visibly alters the motion in Incular but not in Flutter until the next target change. This is a Flutter quirk; the parity target needs a decision.
cause: Flutter binds the curved animation to the tween only on target change; Incular reads the current curve on every build.
fix_direction: Decide whether to match Flutter (keep the running curve until the next target change) or keep the current behavior and document it as an intentional difference.
limitations: Traced for AnimatedOpacity only. Other Flutter implicit widgets bind their curved animation in didUpdateTweens and are likely to behave the same, not verified.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
